notes: Modified cash basis audit, FYE 9/30/2022. Governmental lines from p4 Totals; Taxes 252,127 and Intergovernmental 161,007 split by the fund schedules (pp9, 11, 13, 14), Other 229,237 split by schedule rows (General Other receipts excluding the 480 'Solid waste closure/postclosure' row, which p4 prints as General Fund Interest; Street supply sales 1,965 and Other 61,655; Econ Dev Other 41; ARPA 50,265 p15). Fund balances 587,818 -> 757,377 in fund_balance fields; cash fields hold the printed 'Cash and equity in pooled cash' (2021 and 2022 Totals, p3), time deposits as investments; county treasurer cash (12,113 / 6,720) not in cash fields (as FY2023). Governmental reconcile on fund balance: 587,818 + 677,185 - 557,626 + 50,000 = 757,377. Business-type (modified cash) from p6-7 Totals: 924,128 + 1,301,762 - 1,148,010 - 50,000 = 1,027,880. Detail: fund budget schedules pp9-15 and proprietary combined budget schedule p16; the all-funds budgetary statement p8 duplicates these and is not recorded. General Fund 'Grant' row has no 2022 actual (budget 37,500), not recorded. Capital outlay without a printed function (General, ARPA, statement total) labelled plain Capital Outlay. Balance sheet: governmental from p3 (fund balance classifications; Assigned to Street improvements 312,992 Totals includes the ARPA column 80,375), business-type from SNP p1 column; totals from p1.
